name: Transmuted Hive Lord

abilities.name: Claw
abilities.description: The Hive Lord swipes at you with its claws, dealing low physical damage.

abilities.name: Double Swipe
abilities.description: A double-hitting claw attack dealing minor physical damage twice.

abilities.name: Quaking Smash
abilities.description: The Hive Lord smashes the ground with its fists, dealing moderate physical damage in an area around it.

abilities.name: Cave In
abilities.description: The Hive Lord repeatedly smashes the ground, dealing continuous direct moderate physical damage to all targets in the room. He also gains a small damage shield. When this shield is burned down, he stops using this ability. His scribs dig underground when he starts this attack.

summary: The Transmuted Hive Lord is a kwama warrior found in Darkshade Caverns II, of which it is a boss. It is an alternate version of The Hive Lord, a miniboss from the same dungeon.
